name: koala-evidence-auto-commit
title: Auto-commit Koala metadata writes so dirty gates stay clean
description: Field report B-c9f5 on 2026-05-15 surfaced two intertwined dirty gate failures. B-6326 (Dirty Ownership Oracle) classified them, but Koala-owned metadata writes still surface as koala_metadata_changes after every CLI invocation and block REVIEW/TEST/DONE flows. Add a scoped auto-commit step that stages and commits ONLY classifier-confirmed koala_metadata paths after Koala CLI mutations, so koala_metadata_changes trends to zero between commands. Skip auto-commit when material_source_changes, fixture_changes, or unexpected_dirty_files coexist so unrelated dirt is never bundled in. Surface what was auto-committed in session brief / story_advance output so users can audit.
